3. To get more glass, craft 1 End Crystal, which requires 1 Ghast Tear and 6 Glass.
4. Now we have 1 Blaze Rod and 1 End Crystal, so we can craft 1 End Eye using 1 Ender Pearl and 1 Blaze Powder.
5. We need to gather more Ender Pearls to craft more Blaze Powder. Crafting 1 Blaze Powder requires 1 Ender Pearl and 1 Blaze Rod, so we can craft 2 Blaze Powders with our current supplies.
6. We now have 2 Blaze Powders and 1 Blaze Rod. With these, we can craft 2 End Eyes, increasing our total to 3 End Eyes and 2 Blaze Powders.
7. To gather more Glass, craft 1 End Crystal, requiring 1 Ghast Tear and 6 Glass. Since we already have 7 Glass, we only need to gather another 1 Ghast Tear.
8. Now we have 3 End Eyes, 4 Blaze Powders, and 1 Ghast Tear. We can craft 3 Blazes, each requiring 1 Blaze Powder, 1 Blaze Rod, and 1 Ghast Tear. This gives us 3 Blazes and 1 Ghast Tear left over.
9. With 3 Blazes, we can craft 3 Blaze Pots, which require 1 Blaze, 1 Blaze Rod, and 1 Blaze Powder. Each Blaze Pot provides an additional 1 Blaze Rod and 1 Blaze Powder, so this gives us 6 additional Blaze Pots and 3 Blazes left over.
10. Now we have 9 Blaze Pots, 6 Blaze Rods, 6 Blaze Powders, and 3 Blazes left over.
11. We now have enough Blaze Powder and Blaze Rods to craft 6 End Eyes, bringing our total to 9 End Eyes.
12. To craft 8 Obsidian, we need 8 Glass. We can find this by crafting 1 End Crystal again, which requires 1 Ghast Tear and 6 Glass. Since we already have 7 Glass, we need 1 more Ghast Tear.
13. With 1 Ghast Tear, we can craft 1 End Crystal, providing us with 8 Glass and 1 Ghast Tear.
14. Finally, we have 8 Glass and 1 Ghast Tear, which allows us to craft 8 Obsidian.
15. With 8 Obsidian, we can now craft an Ender Chest using the recipe that requires 8 Obsidian and 1 Ender Eye.

2. Craft 1 Blaze Rod with 1 Ender Pearl and 1 Ghast Tear (we will gather more later).

4. Craft 1 End Eye with 1 Ender Pearl and 1 Blaze Powder (we will gather more later).
5. Craft 2 Blaze Powders with 2 Ender Pearls and 2 Blaze Rods.

8. Craft 9 End Eyes.

This completes the process step-by-step to achieve the goal of crafting an Ender Chest.
